edition-consulted.switches: sortMerge1985: below 2002 an SD's entry skips EntryShapeFindings (numeric/figurative literal-1); a relative file is not an SD, so its findings are reported

reader.notes: AssignTargetRule screens a numeric literal and every figurative constant, including ALL literal, into EntryShapeFindings, and Screen reports them for every non-SD entry at every edition. Non-1985 literal forms are refused by the version pass. The implementor-name mapping is the documented determination. Messages cite §2023:12.4.5.2 SR4.
